label: Particle Physics
description: Theoretical and experimental particle physics, high-energy collisions, detectors, and fundamental interactions.
summary: Particle Physics is represented as a curated static OpenAlex topic profile. Aggregate queries match 78,223 works across five completed years. The separate eligible sample contains 880 authors and 414 institutions. Sampled topic assignments include Advanced Mathematical Theories and Applications; Fermi National Accelerator Laboratory is one institution to investigate.
